events.description: Now on exhibit at the Geneseo Quilt Gallery is the second seasonal show of quilts made by members of the Geneseo Quilt Guild. These colorful and artistic creations show the skill of local artisans while also demonstrating some of the many reasons a quilt might be made. One quilt, titled “Y2K Millennium Charm Quilt” , has a fascinating history as it took over 22 years to be completed with 2000 pieces. These individual pieces came from many States in America as well as Guam, France, Russia, Saudi Arabia and other countries. What an unusual statement of cooperation across borders! The Geneseo Quilt Gallery can be found in the Upper Mezzanine of the Smith Studio and Gallery in downtown Geneseo.

events.name: Restorative Yoga
events.description: Restorative yoga is a slow, gentle style of yoga focused on deep relaxation rather than strength or flexibility. Using props like bolsters, blankets, and blocks, the body is fully supported in a small number of passive poses, each held for several minutes (often five to twenty). This allows the nervous system to shift out of "fight or flight" and into a calm, restful state, easing tension, reducing stress, and promoting deep rest and healing.

events.name: Restorative Yoga
events.description: Restorative yoga is a slow, gentle style of yoga focused on deep relaxation rather than strength or flexibility. Using props like bolsters, blankets, and blocks, the body is fully supported in a small number of passive poses, each held for several minutes (often five to twenty). This allows the nervous system to shift out of "fight or flight" and into a calm, restful state, easing tension, reducing stress, and promoting deep rest and healing.
